name: EcomXray
summary: Shows cost price, gross margin, current stock and net units sold over 30, 90 and 365 days for every Shopify product, with restock advice from real sales velocity.
best_for: small and mid-size Shopify merchants who want cost price, gross margin, clean net unit sales and restock advice inside the admin instead of exporting to a spreadsheet
skip_if: you sell across several channels and need cross-platform inventory sync, you already run a dedicated inventory or MRP system, or you want an app with a public track record longer than a month
honest_knock:
The split between the two tiers is unusually clean, and worth seeing clearly: everything this app is described as doing, the margins, the net units, the restock advice, is free. The $29 buys editing, not insight. If you are happy making changes in the Shopify admin you already have, the free plan is the whole product and the paid one is a convenience layer over it.

The track record is the real caveat, and it has not moved. The app launched on 20 July 2026 and still had no reviews at all when we checked on 8 September, seven weeks later. Nothing is known about how it behaves at scale, how it handles a catalogue in the tens of thousands, or how quickly support answers, because nobody has said so in public.

And its numbers are only as good as your cost prices. Gross margin comes out of Shopify's own cost-per-item field, so if that field is empty or stale across your catalogue, the margin column is decoration. Fill the cost prices in first, then judge the app.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 8 September 2026 on apps.shopify.com/ecomxray; unchanged since 21 August 2026) Two tiers. Free: product analytics inside Shopify, cost price and gross margin, net units sold over 30, 90 and 365 days with refunds, cancellations and test orders excluded, 30-day restock recommendations and a revenue rank for top products. Pro is $29 a month, with a 14-day free trial. It carries everything in Free plus editing product name, description and price in place, SEO fields with automatic URL redirects, publishing to channels and managing collections. There is also a full product activity log, and a Chrome extension showing stock value and editing on your storefront product pages. There is no annual rate on the listing. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Developer aMemory ApS, Ellegardvej 36, Sonderborg, Denmark; the app launched 20 July 2026 and, seven weeks on, still carries a 0.0 rating from zero reviews. The listing's own summary bullets put in-place editing and the audit log among the app's five headline features without marking them Pro, which is the one place the listing reads as more generous than the plan table it sits above.
